events.name: Bash
events.head: Run preflight and look for runner hook
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; python3 app/scripts/shots/claude-app-shots.py preflight 2>&1 | tail -15; grep -rn "claude-app-shots\|preflight" workshop-plan/tasks/*.py workshop-plan/tasks/*.sh app/scripts/run-chain.sh 2>/dev/null | head -20; ls workshop-plan/tasks/ | head -40

events.name: Bash
events.head: Find runner sweep script
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; ls workshop-plan/tasks/ | sed -n 40,100p | tr '\n' ' '; echo; grep -rln "launch-control-agent" workshop-plan/tasks/ app/scripts 2>/dev/null | grep -v '\.log\|\.json' | head; grep -rn "T-351\|shots" workshop-plan/tasks/*.py 2>/dev/null | head

events.name: Bash
events.head: Outline runner.py
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/workshop-plan/tasks; wc -l runner.py; grep -n "^def \|^    def \|sweep\|def main\|while True\|time.sleep" runner.py | head -80

events.name: Bash
events.head: Check imports, pass.py API, preflight timing
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/workshop-plan/tasks; grep -n "^import\|^from\|^lc\|^LANE\|^import pass\|lc = " runner.py | head; grep -n "^def " pass.py | head -60; time python3 ../../app/scripts/shots/claude-app-shots.py preflight >/dev/null 2>&1; grep -n "StartInterval" ~/Library/LaunchAgents/com.tantra.launch-control-agent.plist -A1 2>/dev/null
